subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should an unrecoverable tool-loop overflow automatically rotate the current session even when no after-compaction hook requested a reset?
rationale: That behavior changes session continuity for existing users and is broader than the scoped plugin hook API; repository evidence cannot establish the intended product policy automatically.

options.title: Keep explicit hook resets only
options.body: Remove the automatic terminal-overflow reset and land only the caller-owned after-compaction hook contract.

options.title: Approve automatic recovery reset
options.body: Keep the automatic reset, but document the lifecycle change and require upgrade and live recovery proof.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit hook resets only
recommendation.body: Remove the automatic terminal-overflow reset and land only the caller-owned after-compaction hook contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits at the context-management and embedded-run ownership boundary rather than within one isolated caller.
